output:
CLAIM NUMBER: 2024-31842  
DATE OF LOSS: 11 June 2024  
POLICY FORMS: HO-0304 ed. 03-24  
LOSS SUMMARY: After three days of heavy rain, water entered the basement through cracks in the slab, soaking carpet and drywall to a depth of 8 inches. Inspection found no plumbing failure, the sump pump was operational, and there was no surface water entry at doors or windows.  

DEDUCTIBLE: $1,000  

COVERAGE POSITION:  
FINDING 1: EXCLUDED – Ground water intrusion excluded under code E‑14 (subsurface water reaching foundation, slab, or basement) [SOURCE: HO-0304_sa_chunk_007 | HO-0304 | EXCLUSION‑TABLE]  
FINDING 2: UNDETERMINED – No wording in HO‑0304 addresses demolition/tear‑out costs; the exclusion table lists only perils, none covering remediation expenses [SOURCE: HO-0304_sa_chunk_007 | HO-0304 | EXCLUSION‑TABLE]  

EXCLUSIONS APPLIED:  
- Ground water intrusion exclusion (code E‑14) as cited in Finding 1.  

OPEN ITEMS: Insured inquiry regarding payment for basement tear‑out.
